NSCameraUsageDescription: FocusMakers needs camera access to measure focus time, record time-lapses, and join cam study. Your study video isn't stored on our servers.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FocusMakers uses the microphone when you talk with your group members in a study room. Only your members can hear you, and your voice isn't recorded or saved.
NSMotionUsageDescription: FocusMakers uses motion data to notice when you pick up or touch your device while studying. Sensor data is used only on your device and is never stored.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Used to see how you found FocusMakers and how well our ads work. Your camera video and face data are never used for ads.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: FocusMakers needs permission to add to your photo library so it can save your time-lapse videos to the Photos app.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used when you save your time-lapse videos to the Photos app.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FocusMakers uses the microphone when you talk with your group members in a study room. Only your members can hear you, and your voice isn't recorded or saved.
